title: 17" food fly net covers
text: 17" food fly net covers. I purchased these to go with my new smoker and accessories.  You need these to cover your fish that you are hardening to keep insects off while this process is happening.  These work as they should.  I use in a low wind area.  I am not sure they would stay on in super windy environment.  You get 8 covers.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
